summary: Section 61 (Story likes + universal LikeButton animations) — backend 7/7 passing (2.5s) and frontend confirmed across Banner Gallery, Comunidad, Story Viewer, and ProviderECard. POST /api/stories/{id}/like toggles correctly, returns {liked, likes_count}; owner self-like blocked with 400 'No puedes dar like a tu propia historia'; non-existent story → 404; GET /like-state returns liked bool; like-count persists on /stories/active and /stories/by-provider; views_count dedup via unique index confirmed. Frontend LikeButton: gallery card 'data-liked' toggles 0→1 with gtm-like-btn class, count went 12→13 in screenshot; story-viewer modal rendered via createPortal (parent=BODY, rect 1440x900); client-as-non-owner sees floating story-viewer-like and toggles correctly; provider-as-owner sees story-views-count (Eye 3), story-likes-count (Heart 0), and story-owner-delete (Eliminar) at the bottom but NO like button; comunidad-post-like-* toggles 0→1; save-ecard-like-btn on /p/{slug} toggles; ecard-recommend-button (renamed RecommendButton) still renders the 'Recomiendas este negocio · 3' pill correctly — no regression.

issues: Image area renders mostly black during testing — the story image URL /api/files/getamano/uploads/... appears to fail loading in the Playwright session (401 in console for one resource). The viewer chrome (header, like button, views/delete) is correctly visible. Likely a /api/files auth or cache header issue unrelated to Section 61; please verify the file endpoint serves the image to authenticated session for stories.

action_items: (LOW) Investigate why /api/files/getamano/uploads//.png returns 401 inside story-viewer for an authenticated client session. The viewer UI works; only the image bytes don't render. Could be httpOnly cookie not auto-forwarded on requests, or the file endpoint requires a different auth scheme.

(NICE-TO-HAVE) On /galeria-banners, count text inside [data-testid='gallery-like-*-count'] updates visually (screenshot confirms 12→13) but Playwright text_content() may have returned a stale value because the count element re-renders mid-animation. Not a functional bug — just a testing-stability hint: read count from data-attribute or wait 1500ms before reading.
(NICE-TO-HAVE) Optional: add Escape-to-close keyboard handler on the story viewer (carried over from iter56 — still applicable).
critical_code_review_comments: toggle_story_like correctly handles MongoDB's naive datetime by re-applying tzinfo=UTC before comparing to datetime.now(tz=UTC). Prevents the 'can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes' bug.
Unique index (story_id, user_id) on story_likes guarantees idempotency — even concurrent double-clicks won't double-count. Verified by alternating toggle (count delta == 1).
Owner check uses provider_user_id == user.user_id; returns 400 with localized Spanish detail. Good.
Likes are not cascade-deleted when a story is deleted — orphans accumulate. Acknowledged by review request as low priority; could add TTL or join-cleanup later.

Frontend LikeButton (file confirmed at /app/frontend/src/components/LikeButton.jsx) emits data-testid + data-testid-count and applies gtm-like-btn + gtm-heart-pulse/color animations via CSS keyframes. Particle system gracefully degrades (navigator.vibrate guarded). 'pill' / 'ghost' / 'floating' variants all rendered in the wild.
RecommendButton.jsx (renamed from old LikeButton.jsx) still works on /p/{slug} as ecard-recommend-button — no import regression after the rename.
Story-viewer uses createPortal(document.body), confirmed by parent.tagName==='BODY' in DOM. Modal correctly fills 1440x900 — escape containing-block CSS issue from iter56 is resolved.

Banner-of-the-week badge has gtm-like-btn data-liked='1' class added (verified in source) — visible only when a banner is currently the weekly winner; not asserted in this test run because the badge wasn't on screen at test time. Behavioral spot-check not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 95% — all interactive LikeButton variants verified (gallery card, story-viewer, comunidad post, save-ecard); banner-of-the-week badge + gallery-modal-like not visually asserted (badge not active at test time, modal variant code-confirmed identical to card)

test_credentials: Used demo.client@getamano.com/client123 (toggling likes) + demo.provider@getamano.com/provider123 (owner-view). Both /api/auth/login → 200 with session_token cookie.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests are self-cleaning — final toggle restores like state for any liked story.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Section 61 ships clean. Backend: 7 tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iter57_story_likes.py — pattern is to call /stories/active to discover provider groups, then /stories/by-provider/{user_id} to drill into individual story_id rows (likes_count + views_count live on the story row, NOT on the group). When testing a NEW story endpoint that needs a story_id, prefer this discovery path over POST /stories (creation requires image_url field — multipart-style payload, not just text). Frontend: createPortal works — viewer rect is 1440x900 with parent=BODY. If a future iter needs to assert count increment text on LikeButton, read [data-testid='{id}-count'] AFTER a 1.2s wait, not 500ms, because animation is 700ms + count-pop overlay. Only one open watch item: /api/files/getamano/uploads/ may need cookie-or-bearer auth — story image renders black in screenshots though all UI controls work.
rca of the issue: Initial test failure (422 on POST /stories) was a test-helper bug: I assumed /stories/active returned {stories: [...]} per group but it actually returns {latest_story_id, stories_count, ...}. Fix: changed helper to use latest_story_id directly and added _story_meta() that calls /stories/by-provider/{user_id} for full row data. No backend/business issue — pure test data shape misunderstanding.
